title: Draft DeFi OS meta-layer architecture spec
description: Write docs/spec/P26_ARCHITECTURE.md for the TOA + SINAX recursive optimization layer on top of the other 25 protocols: the canonical protocol registry (wrapping src/sincor2/defi/catalog.py), the fee telemetry ingestor, the ROI ranker, the kill-switch executor, the TOA feedback loop, and the dashboard API. It states the meta invariant: the OS ranks by fee generation and kills negative-ROI ticks but produces no yield itself. Done looks like a reviewed spec with component boundaries and the kill authority chain defined.

title: Build the TOA recursive feedback loop
description: Build the recursive optimization loop: the OS feeds rankings and kill outcomes back into TOA ingest_feedback so TOA reprioritizes revenue paths across the 25 protocols, closing the self-improvement cycle.
